summary: Transform your fleet management approach with our training designed for sustainable profits. Gain insights to improve efficiency and support environmental goals
lede: Fleet management training helps fleet supervisors, transport coordinators, and operations teams manage vehicle costs, uptime, and transport performance. Participants learn to calculate operating costs, plan preventive maintenance and fuel controls, and use telematics, utilization, and downtime data to guide replacement decisions and report fleet KPIs. The course also covers driver and vehicle checks, safety procedures, and practical improvement planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage fleet cost, vehicle uptime, fuel control, and transport performance in operational settings.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a working knowledge of fleet operations, transport coordination, or vehicle-based service delivery. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading operational reports, maintenance logs, fuel records, and basic cost summaries. A calculator or spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets will be useful for the hands-on exercises, and familiarity with telematics or fleet management software will help you move faster through the applied activities.
